hwatch
======

A modern alternative to the watch command. hwatch records command execution results, keeps a history, and can show diffs between runs.

Features
--------
- Records command outputs over time and keeps a history of results.
- Shows differences between executions and supports multiple diff modes.
- Can output results as JSON logs.

- Supports ANSI color codes and scrollable output.

Usage
-----

    hwatch [OPTIONS] [command]...

Common options (user-facing):
- -b, --batch       : Output execution results to stdout instead of the UI.
- -c, --color       : Interpret ANSI color and style sequences in command output.
- -n, --interval    : Seconds to wait between updates (default: 2).
- -l, --logfile     : Write execution history as a JSON log file.
- -h, --help        : Print help.

Configuration
-------------
You can set default options using an environment variable (for example, HWATCH) if you want to always enable certain flags.

Examples
--------
Run a command every 3 seconds:

    hwatch -n 3 command...

Log command outputs to a JSON file:

---------------
